paper_title: Extensive search for axion dark matter over 1\,GHz with CAPP's Main Axion eXperiment
notes: Paper reports a new axion-photon coupling exclusion limit from CAPP-MAX cavity haloscope over 1.025-1.185 GHz (4.24-4.91 ueV). Local DM density assumed is 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (from Eq. 1). However, the provided paper content is truncated and does not include the actual exclusion limit data table or numerical g_agamma values (the results section V is cut off). No extractable data points available. | Vision: Result is the narrow dark-navy 'This work' (CAPP MAX) region spanning 4.24-4.91 ueV (1.025-1.185 GHz). The zoom inset uses normalized units (g/g_DFSZ); I converted using the DFSZ band position at these masses (~6e-16 GeV^-1 at ~4.5 ueV). Lower boundary reaches near DFSZ (ratio ~0.7-1) with peaks where gaps in coverage occur. Absolute coupling values are approximate, derived from the DFSZ benchmark line on the main plot. | CV axis calibration: x-max corrected 30->124.29; | Calibration: No calibration needed (spot-check verify/stage2 raw_ratio=0.83 snapped to identity)
